user.title: Connect to Aquascape Smart Control
user.description: Enter your 32-character Aquascape / Blynk Auth Token from {console_url} (under Devices -> Device Info -> BLYNK_AUTH_TOKEN).

error.cannot_connect: Failed to connect to the Aquascape Smart Control cloud API.
error.invalid_auth: Invalid Auth Token. Make sure you entered the 32-character BLYNK_AUTH_TOKEN from the web console, not the hyphenated Device UID.
